keyEvents.text: Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 0, Stuttgart 1. Ermedin Demirovic (Stuttgart) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Equi Fernández (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 0, Stuttgart 2. Jamie Leweling (Stuttgart) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal following a corner.
Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1, Stuttgart 2. Patrik Schick (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Aleix García with a cross following a corner.
Facundo Medina (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card.
Aleix García (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card.
Jeff Chabot (Stuttgart) is shown the yellow card.
Luca Jaquez (Stuttgart) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1, Stuttgart 2.
Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1, Stuttgart 3. Bilal El Khannouss (Stuttgart) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Chris Führich.
Ibrahim Maza (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Atakan Karazor (Stuttgart) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Jonas Hofmann replaces Lucas Vázquez.
Ermedin Demirovic (Stuttgart) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Maximilian Mittelstädt replaces Chris Führich.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Finn Jeltsch replaces Luca Jaquez.

Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1, Stuttgart 4. Ermedin Demirovic (Stuttgart) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the top right corner. Assisted by Deniz Undav following a fast break.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Nikolas Nartey replaces Deniz Undav.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Malik Tillman replaces Afonso Moreira.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Robert Andrich replaces Equi Fernández.
Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2, Stuttgart 4. Ibrahim Maza (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Miguel Gutiérrez with a cross.
Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Victor Boniface replaces Aleix García.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Dzenan Pejcinovic replaces Bilal El Khannouss.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Ameen Al-Dakhil replaces Jamie Leweling.
